item.title: Sally Rooney Book Withdrawal Is Absurd. Palestine Action Is Not a Terror Group
item.description: If Fyodor Dostoevsky were alive today he would be appearing on Russia Today to cheer on Vladimir Putin’s invasion of Ukraine. The author of The Brothers Karamazov, Crime and Punishment and other great works of the literary canon was also prone to anti-Semitic outbursts and was vitriolic in his denunciation of the Roman Catholic church, nineteenth-century Western liberals and their Russian admirers who wanted to reform his beloved Tsarist autocracy.
item.dc:creator: Martin Ivens

item.title: The West May Have Forgotten Arnold Toynbee, But China Hasn’t
item.description: Arnold Toynbee was once the most famous historian in the world, Niall Ferguson, Jared Diamond and Simon Schama rolled into one. item.dc:creator: Adrian Wooldridge

item.title: A Bruising Battle Awaits Musk and SpaceX in Mobile Services
item.description: Elon Musk’s decision to wade into US mobile-phone services sets up a challenge distinct from anything he’s previously pursued. This is not a new market or an added twist that fills an industry gap such as his innovations with electric vehicles, broadband from low-earth orbit or an online payment system — the areas where Musk made his riches.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Black
